title: Beef mince with cauliflower rice
steps: Chop the onion. Grate the cauliflower on the large holes of a grater, or pulse it in a food processor, until it looks like rice.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat, add the mince and onion and fry for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking up the mince, until browned with no pink left.
Add the tomatoes and a pinch of herbs and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the spinach until it wilts, and season with salt and pepper.
Microwave the cauliflower rice in a covered bowl for 3 to 4 minutes, or dry-fry it in a hot pan for 4 minutes, stirring, until tender.
Serve the mince on top of the cauliflower rice.
